summary.text: David Couch is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a member of the Kern County Board of Supervisors, representing District 4 since 2013.

paragraphs.text: Couch won election to the Kern County Board of Supervisors District 4 seat in 2018 as an incumbent, defeating Grace Vallejo and Jose Gonzalez in the general election.
He won outright in the 2020 nonpartisan primary against Emilio Huerta and in the 2024 primary against three other candidates.
His current term on the board ends on January 8, 2029.
